pageTitle: Chromatic Ode of Candies and Roses/Rocking Carriage
name: Rocking Carriage
description: A game run by the "Phantom Toy Master" Masud that is imbued with a heartwarming fairytale- "Smart or not, nice or naughty, every child with a good heart will receive their own Flower Carriage during the Sabzeruz Festival celebrations..." "Riding in their carriage, the children shall embark on unique adventures, encountering and overcoming danger, and finding the greatest treasure, a thousand blooming flowers..."|Map Marker Description
